section.53: The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

53.name_native: The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

hadiths.text: Abdullah b. Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah intends to chastise a people, He chastises all of them then they would be raised according to their deeds
